sn22.57:1.2: Sattaṭṭhānakusalo bhikkhave bhikkhu tividhūpaparikkhī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso ti vuccati || || 4

sn22.57:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu rūpam pajānāti || rūpasamudayam pajānāti || rūpanirodham pajānāti || rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadam pajānāti ||
sn22.57:1.5: rūpassa assādam pajānāti || rūpassa ādīnavam pajānāti || rūpassa nissaraṇam pajānāti -

sn22.57:3.1: Yaṃ rūpam paṭicca uppajjati sukham somanassam
sn22.57:4.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ rūpam abhiññāya evaṃ rūpasamudayam abhiññāya evaṃ rūpanirodham abhiññāya evaṃ rūpanirodhagāminim paṭipadam abhiññāya ||

sn22.57:5.1: Ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ rūpam abhiññāya evaṃ rūpasamudayam abhiññāya evaṃ rūpanirodham abhiññāya || evaṃ rūpanirodhagāminim paṭipadam abhiññāya ||
sn22.57:5.2: evaṃ rūpassa assādam abhiññāya evaṃ rūpassa ādīnavam abhiññāya evaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇam abhiññāya rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā te suvimuttā ||
